_comment: MOCK: stand-in scheme criteria until Jaya's human-verified data/schemes/<id>.json files exist. Same shape as PLAN §4.4 (only the fields the eligibility engine reads). Criteria are simplified for testing and must not be presented as official rules.

criteria.text_hi: परिवार के नाम पर खेती योग्य ज़मीन होनी चाहिए
criteria.text_gu: પરિવારના નામે ખેતીલાયક જમીન હોવી જોઈએ

criteria.text_hi: आयकर देने वाले परिवार पात्र नहीं हैं

criteria.text_en: Serving or retired government employees are excluded
criteria.text_hi: सरकारी या रिटायर्ड सरकारी कर्मचारी पात्र नहीं हैं
criteria.text_gu: સરકારી અથવા નિવૃત્ત સરકારી કર્મચારીઓ પાત્ર નથી

criteria.text_en: Must have a bank or post office savings account
Household must not already have an LPG connection
Must belong to a poor household (category list on the official page)
